name: Synthetify
rootCause: On October 19, Synthetify Protocol experienced a security incident. The smart contract and the entire platform are currently frozen.

descriptions.text: On October 19, Synthetify Protocol experienced a security incident. The smart contract and the entire platform are currently frozen.

On October 19, 2023, Synthetify's protocol on Solana was exploited via a malicious governance proposal, resulting in an unrecovered loss of $230,000 in protocol assets. The attacker exploited inactive DAO governance by submitting and passing a harmful proposal to transfer treasury funds. Synthetify’s governance process permitted a malicious proposal to be submitted and executed with insufficient community oversight or technical defense (delay, supervision, or veto), enabling the protocol treasury's assets to be transferred without intervention.
